Declare @Today Date
	Set @Today = (Select LastRunDate From LastBatchRunTbl)
; with CTETodaysStockAndGIT as (
select SKUCode, WhCode, Stock,GIT from  RationingHistory 
where ReportDate=@Today
)
select 
A.ParentWhCode, ParentWhName=Replace(A.ParentWhName,',',''), A.SKUCode, SKUName=Replace(A.SKUName,',',''), A.WhCode, WhName=Replace(A.WhName,',',''), A.IsNormed, A.Req,  c9=Replace(ISNULL(B.c9,'-'),',',''),	c10=Replace(ISNULL(B.c10,'-'),',',''),c12=Replace(ISNULL(B.c12,'-'),',',''),c13=Replace(ISNULL(B.c13,'-'),',',''),[DispatchAdviceQuantity]=case when NULLIF(A.ParentNorm,'') is not null then A.RationedReq else A.SupplierDispatchReq end,
 A.DispatchPen,A.DispatchColor, Dispatch ,ReportDate, [BOR/RRR]=case when NULLIF(A.ParentNorm,'') is not null then 'RRR' else 'BOR' end ,
Stock=E.Stock , GIT=E.GIT
 ,TOR_B, TOR_R, TOY, TOG
from RationingHistory A
left join SkuLocAttributeData B on a.SKUCode=B.SKUCode and a.WhCode=B.LocCode
left join [$(BPRDatabase)].dbo.vf_PickListReport C on A.SKUCode=c.SKUCode and a.WhCode=C.WhCode and A.ParentWhCode=C.ParentWhCode
left join CTETodaysStockAndGIT E on A.SKUCode=E.SKUCode and A.WhCode=E.WhCode
where ReportDate > DATEADD(day,-45,@Today) and NULLIF(A.ParentNorm,'') is null

,'Stock','GIT','TOB(Rationed)','TOR(Rationed)','TOY(Rationed)','TOG(Rationed)'

select A.[SKUCode], '"' + S1.[SKUDescription] + '"', A.[WhCode], '"' + S2.[WHDescription] + '"'
	,A.[SupplierCode], '"' + S3.[WHDescription] + '"', A.Norm,A.Stock,A.VirtualNorm,A.GIT,ParentLeftoverStock, Requirement
	,Req_TOB,Req_TOR,Req_TOY,Req_TOG,Req_TOBlue,DispatchQty

	,ISNULL(D.c9,'-'), ISNULL(D.c10,'-'),ISNULL(D.c12,'-'), ISNULL(D.c13,'-'), E.c3, D.c11, D.c7
	from [BORWithOrderAllocation] A
	inner join ColorSequence C on A.DispatchColor=C.Color
	left join [SKUDescriptionTbl] S1 on A.[SKUCode] = S1.[SKUCode]
	left join [SiteDescriptionTbl] S2 on A.[WhCode] = S2.[WHCode]
	left join [SiteDescriptionTbl] S3 on A.[SupplierCode] = S3.[WHCode]
	left join SkuLocAttributeData D on A.[SKUCode]=D.[SKUCode] and A.[WhCode]=D.[LocCode]
	left join SkuAttributeData E on A.[SKUCode]=E.[SKUCode]
	order by C.SequenceNo Asc,OrderBlackUnsatisfiedPercentage desc,OrderRedUnsatisfiedPercentage desc,OrderYellowUnsatisfiedPercentage desc      
	,OrderGreenUnsatisfiedPercentage desc,A.DispatchPen desc;

Query:
SELECT

    sod.OrderKey,
    sod.CustomerOrderId,
    sod.PartId,
    sod.IsSpike,
    sod.IsElephant,
    sod.OriginalQty,
    sod.Qty,
    sod.SKUCode,
    sod.WhCode,
    sod.FirstServicingWhCode,
    sod.DueDate,
    sod.IntroDate

FROM SpikeOrderData sod;

Declare @Today Date
				Set @Today = (Select LastRunDate From LastBatchRunTbl)

				;WITH LatestRemarkCTE AS (
					SELECT
						SKUCode,
						WhCode,
						suppliercode,
						Remark,
						RemarkDate,
						ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SKUCode, WhCode ORDER BY RemarkDate DESC) AS rn
					FROM BORReport_OARemarkDetails
				)

				select 
                A.[SKUCode],
                REPLACE(S1.[SKUDescription], ',', ' ') AS SKUDescription,
                A.[WhCode],
                REPLACE(S2.[WHDescription], ',', ' ') AS LocDesciption,
                A.[SupplierCode],
                REPLACE(S3.[WHDescription], ',', ' ') AS SupplierDescription,
                A.Norm,A.Stock,A.VirtualNorm,A.GIT,ParentLeftoverStock
		        ,Requirement,Req_TOB,Req_TOR,Req_TOY,Req_TOG,Req_TOBlue,DispatchQty
		        ,Dispatch_TOB,Dispatch_TOR,Dispatch_TOY,Dispatch_TOG,Dispatch_ToBlue,A.DispatchColor,AdvAllocDone,
               D.c9,D.c10,F.Remark,D.c7,D.c11,D.c12,D.c13,E.c3,A.ReportDate
            from [BOR_OrderAllocationHistory] A
                inner join ColorSequence C on A.DispatchColor=C.Color
                left join [SKUDescriptionTbl] S1 on A.[SKUCode] = S1.[SKUCode]
                left join [SiteDescriptionTbl] S2 on A.[WhCode] = S2.[WHCode]
                left join [SiteDescriptionTbl] S3 on A.[SupplierCode] = S3.[WHCode]
                left join vf_ReqCalculation B on A.[SKUCode]=B.[SKUCode] and A.[WhCode]=B.[WhCode]
				left join SkuLocAttributeData D on A.SKUCode=D.SKUCode and A.WhCode=D.LocCode
				left join SkuAttributeData E on A.SKUCode=E.SKUCode
				LEFT JOIN LatestRemarkCTE F ON A.SKUCode = F.SKUCode AND A.WhCode = F.WhCode and A.SupplierCode=F.SupplierCode  AND F.rn = 1
				where ReportDate BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY, -44, @Today) AND @Today

	, 'Norm','Stock','Virtual Norm','GIT/Pending', 'Parent Leftover Stock', 'Requirement'

	, ' Final Req TOB', ' Final Req TOR', ' Final Req TOY', ' Final Req TOG', 'Final Req ToBlue', 'Dispatch_Color'
	,'Adv Allocation','Continuous Black(With Plant WIP)','Continuous Black and Red(With Plant WIP)','Latest Remark','Filling Line','ABCxFMS','Continuous Black(Without Plant WIP)','Continuous Black and Red(Without Plant WIP)','Unit Pack Size','ReportDate'
